name: Transformer cooling stage-one request
aliases: substations Transformer regulation and cooling control
summary: Requests the first documented group of installed cooling equipment.
description: Requests the first documented group of installed cooling equipment. Transformer regulation changes the selected winding connection to influence voltage, while cooling control manages the installed fans and pumps. Commands, mechanical position and measured results belong to different parts of the diagram.

In a substation, a voltage regulator can request a tap change and check the resulting tap-position feedback. A separate controller stages cooling equipment according to the transformer manufacturer's defined conditions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Thermal-control demand” at the input and “First cooling-group command” at the output. Cooling group composition is transformer-specific.

Keep tap-change permission, limit contacts, movement indication and measured voltage distinct. Actual tap positions, time delays, cooling ratings and allowable parallel operation require the selected transformer control design. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
